steps.code:
# Compute most common genre per playlist and update titles.
playlist_song_genres = {
    324: ['R&B','EDM','pop','reggae','EDM'],
    325: ['jazz','R&B','reggae','indie','country','R&B'],
    326: ['EDM','EDM','reggae','country','R&B','classical'],
    327: ['indie','jazz','EDM','EDM']
}

for pid, genres in playlist_song_genres.items():
    from collections import Counter
    most_common = Counter(genres).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Get current playlist title
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(access_token=_mem['s6']['access_token'], playlist_id=pid)
    new_title = f"{pl['title']} | {most_common}"
    print(f"Updating playlist {pid}: {pl['title']} -> {new_title}")
    apis.spotify.update_playlist(access_token=_mem['s6']['access_token'], playlist_id=pid, title=new_title)

# Check all pages of the playlist library to ensure we cover all playlists.
access_token = _mem['s6']['access_token']
all_playlists = []
page = 0
while True:
    batch = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not batch:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(batch)
    if len(batch) < 20:
        break
    page += 1
print(f"Total playlists found: {len(all_playlists)}")
for pl in all_playlists:
    print(pl['playlist_id'], pl['title'])
